finding: Slovak turnover still contracting despite 13 pp improvement in wave 39
bullets: A net 12.83% of Slovak firms (n=242) reported declining turnover in wave 39, improving 13.39 pp from a net 26.22% decline in wave 38 — yet still signalling weak demand conditions.
A net 34.38% of Slovak firms (n=242) reported falling profits — 18.99 pp worse than the EA's net 15.39% — highlighting profitability pressures.
Labour costs continued to rise for a net 78.81% of Slovak firms (n=242), 19.85 pp above the EA's net 58.96% — squeezing margins further.
chart_subtitle: A net 12.83% of Slovak firms still reported turnover declines.
